title: Witness phase result
description: The typed record the witness phase returns to the loop orchestrator. The verdict gates convergence; each check names the ground truth it read; each violation names the phase that fixes it. Mirrors the durable record written to .allium-loop/<slug>.witness.json.

verdict.description: PASS only when every check with evidence passed; INCONCLUSIVE when there was no evidence to witness

name.description: e.g. tests-pass, no-test-weakened, coverage, weed-verdict, open-questions, convergence, red-before-green

ground_truth.description: the evidence read: runner exit status, hash comparison, reconciliation line, weed verdict, open-questions diff

violations.description: empty when verdict is PASS; each names its routing

routing.description: the phase that resolves it (e.g. revert + propagate, implement, escalate)
